_comment: Copy to config.json. THE DEFAULT POINTS AT tools/fakeircd.py, NOT a real network.
IRC publishes the host of every client that connects, so running this from a home
machine announces your home IP to everyone in the channel. Point it at a real
network only when it runs on the VPS, or once Q auth + usermode +x is in place.
See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Upstream credentials and host exposure'.
Start the local server first:  python tools/fakeircd.py --port 6699

_quakenet_example.name: QuakeNet
_quakenet_example._warning: Exposes the host of whatever machine runs this. VPS only.
